ai.choice-hint: How it works: below, use “Create provider” to add a provider with your key, for example Google Gemini (free, step-by-step guide right below). For text and recipes @:{'kh.app.name'} uses the top provider of the list; photos and screenshots are read by the top one that reads images; change the order with the arrows. Audio and video: An audio provider only worked with providers that offer OpenAI's speech-to-text interface (in practice only OpenAI/ChatGPT) and only served the video download @:{'kh.app.name'} does not do. Your own recordings are transcribed by the Whisper add-on instead; it runs locally and needs no key.
ai.order-hint: The AI asks the providers from top to bottom. If one fails, it takes the next.
ai.profile-lokal: Profile "lokal": everything stays in the house. Use only local AI providers (e.g. Ollama), no cloud keys.

free-keys.title: Free keys
free-keys.hint: One provider is enough, ideally one that reads photos. More are a reserve: when one runs out of quota, @:{'kh.app.name'} takes the next. Free tiers change often; the test button shows whether a model fits. You enter the keys yourself.

guide.title: Step by step: set up Gemini (free)
guide.key: Get a key: open the page below, sign in with your Google account, tap "Create API key" and copy the key. Do not add a billing account there; then it costs nothing.
guide.preset: Back in @:{'kh.app.name'}, tap here. The window opens already filled in; you only paste the key into the "API Key" field. Best leave the tick "Also add Gemini Reserve" on: when the first model's daily quota runs out, @:{'kh.app.name'} takes the second one automatically.
guide.test: Tap "Create". @:{'kh.app.name'} then tests the new providers itself; after a few seconds the list shows whether they work and read photos. If it shows an error, the key is usually wrong: tap the pencil icon next to the provider, paste the key again and tap "Update".
guide.mistakes: Common mistakes: when pasting the key, no space may come before or after it. The Model field takes the ID such as "gemini-3.5-flash-lite", not the name "Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite" from Google; the preset fills it in correctly.

setup.asks-for: While adding it, the device asks for two things:

prompt.text-computer: Set up @:{'kh.app.name'} here in 2 minutes: icon in the Dock or as an app, shopping list, shortcuts.

home.installed: You are using @:{'kh.app.name'} as an app right now. This is already done.

ios.title: @:{'kh.app.name'} on the home screen
ios.s2: Tap Share (the square with the arrow).
ios.s3: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap Add.

android.title: @:{'kh.app.name'} on the home screen
android.s2: Tap the menu ⋮ at the top right.
android.s3: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

mac.title: @:{'kh.app.name'} in the Dock
mac.s1: Safari (macOS Sonoma or newer): open @:{'kh.app.name'} and choose File → “Add to Dock”.
mac.s2: Chrome or Edge: click the install icon in the address bar.
mac.s3: Confirm with “Add” or “Install”. Then you start @:{'kh.app.name'} like any other app.

computer.title: @:{'kh.app.name'} as an app
computer.s2: Click the install icon in the address bar (or menu → “Install app”).

ios.title: Shopping list as its own icon
ios.s1: Tap “Open shopping list”. It opens in Safari.
ios.s4: Tap Add. The icon opens the list right away.

android.title: Shopping list as its own icon
android.s1: Press and hold the @:{'kh.app.name'} icon on the home screen.
android.s3: Drag the entry onto the home screen.

mac.title: Shopping list in the Dock
mac.s2: Safari: File → “Add to Dock”. Chrome or Edge: install icon in the address bar.

computer.title: Shopping list as its own app
computer.s2: Click the install icon in the address bar.

key.label: Your key
key.once: The key is only visible while this page is open. @:{'kh.app.name'} deliberately does not store it in readable form, so nobody can read it from the server. If you need it again later, just create a new one; delete old ones under Profile → API tokens.
key.one-each: You can use a separate key for each shortcut; then you can delete one without touching the others.

ios.title: Key for shortcuts
ios.s2: Copy the key right away, it is only visible now.
ios.s3: Paste it when you add a shortcut and the device asks for it.

android.title: Key for shortcuts
android.s2: Copy the key right away, it is only visible now.
android.s3: You only need it for apps and automations that reach @:{'kh.app.name'}.

mac.title: Key for shortcuts
mac.s1: On the Mac you can create your own key: click the button below.
mac.s2: Copy the key right away, it is only visible now.
mac.s3: You can also use the iPhone's key. One key per device can be deleted on its own.

computer.title: Key for shortcuts
computer.s2: Copy the key right away, it is only visible now.

import.with-link: Tap “Add shortcut”. Afterwards “Import to Cookbook” appears in the share menu of Safari, Instagram, Photos and Files.

ios.title: Import recipes from other apps
ios.s1: Open the Shortcuts app, tap + and turn on “Show in Share Sheet” under ⓘ (types text, URLs, images, files and PDFs).
ios.s2: Build the shortcut “Import to Cookbook” following the README (section “Share by shortcut”): one request sends everything, @:{'kh.app.name'} recognizes photo, PDF, text and link itself.
ios.s3: Then it appears in the share menu of Safari, Instagram, Photos and Files.

mac.title: Import recipes from other apps
mac.s1: Shortcuts from the iPhone reach the Mac through iCloud: Shortcuts → Settings → iCloud Sync.
mac.s2: “Import to Cookbook” then appears in Safari's share menu on the Mac.
mac.s3: If you do not have it yet, set it up on the iPhone first.

android.title: Import recipes from other apps
android.s1: @:{'kh.app.name'} is right in the share menu of other apps. Nothing to do here.

siri.with-link: Tap “Add shortcut”. Afterwards “Hey Siri, Add to shopping list” works.
siri.android-note: Google Assistant cannot do “Add to shopping list”. On Android you type items straight into the shopping list.

ios.title: “Hey Siri, Add to shopping list”
ios.s1: Build the shortcut “Add to shopping list” in the Shortcuts app (instructions in the README).
ios.s2: It needs the key from above and the address of @:{'kh.app.name'}.
ios.s3: Then say “Hey Siri, Add to shopping list” and dictate what is missing.

mac.title: “Hey Siri, Add to shopping list”
mac.s1: The shortcut from the iPhone reaches the Mac through iCloud (Shortcuts → Settings → iCloud Sync).
mac.s2: Then “Hey Siri, Add to shopping list” works on the Mac too.

ios.title: Clock timer
ios.s1: Under More → Settings → Timer turn on “Put on Clock timer”.
ios.s2: The timer then rings even when the device is locked.

mac.title: Clock timer
mac.s1: Under More → Settings → Timer turn on “Put on Clock timer” and add the shortcut with the button there (it opens in the Shortcuts app).
mac.s2: The timer then starts in the Clock app, even when @:{'kh.app.name'} is no longer in front.

plan.title: Meal plan
plan.text: Someone in the household plans a dish.

evening.title: Evening reminder
evening.text: The evening before: what is cooked tomorrow, with hints for thawing and preparing.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.text: Someone puts things on a list. Several arrive bundled.

intake.title: Inbox
intake.text: A recipe is ready for review.

news.title: What's new
news.text: After an update with new functions, once.

planner.sunday-note: Sunday counts as “not chosen” in @:{'kh.app.name'}; the week then starts on Monday.

note.title: Our note
note.placeholder: e.g. Less sugar, the kids like it so

wizard.seed: Create foods, units and departments (needed for the shopping list tiles)
wizard.ai-hint: Optional. Links with recipe data and @:{'kh.app.name'} files work without AI. For photos, text and speech you need a provider; free keys are listed further down.

addons.intro: What do you need? You can change this any time under More → Add-ons.
addons.recipes: Collect and cook recipes, without shopping list and meal plan.
addons.shopping: Plus the tile shopping list, also in the shop without signal.
addons.planner: Plus the week plan with wishes and suggestions.

family.title: Family
family.intro: Who else cooks with you? Add the people right here. You can skip this step and do it later under Admin → Users.
family.name: Name
family.invite-hint: Without mail sending each person gets a temporary password from you. Or create an invite link under Profile.
family.created-hint: You only see the password now. Send the text to the person or read it out.
family.welcome: Address {origin}, username {username}, temporary password {password} — at the first sign-in {name} chooses their own.

problem.name: Name is missing
problem.taken: Username or e-mail is already taken

family.intolerances-failed: {name} was added, but what they cannot tolerate could not be saved.
family.tour-failed: {name} was added, but the introduction could not be switched on.
family.simple-failed: {name} was added, but the simple view could not be switched on.
family.pending-title: One person has not been added yet. Add now? | {n} people have not been added yet. Add now?

check.title: Check
check.intro: The most important things at a glance. Nothing is changed here; the full list is under More → Settings → System check.

end.intro: These help you get going with @:{'kh.app.name'}
end.import-url: Enter the address of a recipe page. @:{'kh.app.name'} reads the recipe there and adds it to your collection.

wizard.previous: Do you already have a backup of @:{'kh.app.name'} or Mealie?
wizard.seed-hint: @:{'kh.app.name'} adds English foods, units and departments, so the shopping list is sorted by department. You can change or add to them at any time.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: Collections are another way to organize recipes: you set filters, and all matching recipes appear in the collection. Each collection gets an entry in the side menu.
collections.hide-other-description: When enabled, only collections from your household appear in the side menu
collections.public-description: Public collections can be shared with people without an account and are shown on your group page.
collections.name: Collection name

kind.title: Account type
kind.family-hint: Everyday use: recipes, shopping, plan, collections, categories and tags
kind.manager-hint: like Family, plus inviting and managing the household

hub.household-statistics-description: Your household statistics give you an insight into how you use @:{'kh.app.name'}.
hub.household-settings-description: Manage your household settings, like meal plan and privacy settings.
hub.webhooks-description: Set up webhooks that trigger on days that you have meal plans scheduled.
hub.manage-data-description: Manage your @:{'kh.app.name'} data: foods, units, categories, tags and more.

tag-suggest.title: Suggest tags
tag-suggest.description: For recipes without tags. Nothing is saved until you confirm it.
tag-suggest.search-ai: Keep looking with AI (10 recipes at a time)
tag-suggest.none: No suggestions found. Either all recipes have tags already, or none of the existing tags fits.
tag-suggest.left: There is no suggestion for {n} more recipes without tags.
tag-suggest.failed: Could not do that. Please try again.
